task_description: Create a fully autonomous single-file HTML application for training and testing statistical problems in a CDI/university platform style. The app must include 13+ task types covering probability theory and mathematical statistics, with data generation, answer checking, step-by-step solutions, multilingual interface (RU/UZ/EN), dark mode, timer, progress tracking, and localStorage persistence. No external dependencies allowed.

verification.summary: File exists (3035 lines), valid JS syntax confirmed via Node.js Function constructor, 7 classes implemented, 8 localStorage references, 0 external dependencies. All mathematical formulas verified correct including corrected variance (n-1), normal quantile (Abramowitz-Stegun), t-distribution quantile lookup table. Review fixes applied: score inflation guard, floating-point bin gap fix, i18n coverage for solution steps.
